title: Collective defence of the territorio: vernacular concepts and practices of security in Colombia’s Pacific South-West
authors: A. Alzate García, J.M. Díaz-Arévalo, J.A. Flórez López et al.
venue: White Rose Research Online (University of Leeds, The University of Sheffield, University of York)
why: Communities in south-west Colombia define security through territorio and their own practices. It is the vernacular, pluriversal counterpoint to participation designed from outside, with empirical grounding.
caveat: An accepted manuscript in a repository with no DOI. Check the version of record before you cite it.
